caption: The drawing depicts a round plate with a decorative floral pattern. The plate has a beige or light tan background with a thin, brownish rim accented by evenly spaced small dots. The main design features stylized, symmetrical tulip-like flowers in orange and reddish-brown tones, with six large blooms arranged in a circular pattern around a central, vertically oriented stem and flower. The stems and leaves, rendered in the same orange and reddish-brown, extend outward in curved lines. Green brush-like accents and patches are scattered throughout the plate's surface, adding contrast to the earthy color scheme. The overall composition is balanced, with the floral elements radiating from the center and filling the interior of the circular plate. The artist's name, "Carl Strehlau," is written in small letters below the plate.
title: Pa. German Plate
